head: a1ae5883a13323f0d5312059b21d225c9c55f9e8
problem_found: The 2026-05-07T13:51Z fanout dry-run contract used COLMAP_INPUT_CHUNK_PLANNER_MANIFEST_URI, but run_colmap_sfm.py did not yet implement that environment variable.

behavior: loads the immutable planner manifest from local path or S3 through load_json_uri
limits extraction to selected chunk image_names when COLMAP_ONLY_CHUNK_INDEXES is set
builds ChunkPlan records from the immutable manifest instead of replanning locally

remaining_gap: This is local runtime support only. The branch/container must be built from this head before launching the two-leaf canary if the canary is meant to prove immutable-manifest fanout rather than the older selected-chunk primitive.
